summary: True Grit is a 1969 American western film and the first adaptation of Charles Portis' 1968 novel of the same name. Marguerite Roberts wrote the screenplay and Henry Hathaway directed. Kim Darby played Mattie Ross and John Wayne played U.S. Marshal Rooster Cogburn, a role that earned Wayne his only Academy Award and that he reprised in the 1975 sequel Rooster Cogburn.
one_line: A 1969 American western directed by Henry Hathaway, adapting Charles Portis' novel, starring John Wayne as Marshal Rooster Cogburn.
key_facts: True Grit is a 1969 American western film.
True Grit is the first film adaptation of Charles Portis' 1968 novel of the same name.
The screenplay for True Grit was written by Marguerite Roberts.
True Grit was directed by Henry Hathaway.
Kim Darby starred as Mattie Ross in True Grit.
John Wayne starred as U.S. Marshal Rooster Cogburn in True Grit.
John Wayne won his only Academy Award for his performance in True Grit.
John Wayne reprised his role of Rooster Cogburn in the 1975 sequel Rooster Cogburn.
